svg.aria-label: Victory path of one Faction of the Bootstrap GDRs, e.g. Red Dawn: Criminal organizations discovers Locate Red Dawn member; in each of eight tiers a locate Lead creates an Initiative Mission site and a Won Mission there discovers a follow-up Lead, with the Red Dawn profile Lead between tiers 1 and 2; after tier 8, Terminate Red Dawn makes the Faction Eliminated, and once all three Factions are Eliminated, Peace on Earth wins the Campaign; throughout the Campaign, the Faction operations create Response Mission sites whose expiration or loss raises Panic until the Campaign is lost, and an existential operation not stopped loses it outright
svg.text: Bootstrap GDRs: the Victory path of one Faction, e.g. Red Dawn
completion discovers; reveals the Faction’s article
once all three Factions are Eliminated, discovers
faint, rising level by level to total war
or another of 16, by operation level
